problems.code:
def f():
    global a, b
    i = 0
    j = 0
    while i < len(a) - 1:
        if a[i] != a[i + 1]:
            b = b[:j] + a[i] + b[j+1:]
            j += 1
        i += 1
a = "aaabbccccdefffff"
b = ""
f()
print(b)
